questions.question: What does expanding the Time Cell Moon Palace domain create?
questions.subject: Time Cell Moon Palace

answer.item: Expanding this domain casts a black empty area save for a few floating particles and the main stage of the environment.

questions.question: What does the auto-hit function of the Time Cell Moon Palace inject into its targets?
questions.subject: Time Cell Moon Palace

answer.item: The auto-hit function of the domain injects films of animation frames into the neck of its targets.

questions.question: What must anyone who moves within the Time Cell Moon Palace abide by?
questions.subject: Time Cell Moon Palace

answer.item: Anyone who moves within the domain must abide by the 24FPS rule of Projection Sorcery or they will receive numerous bloody injuries with every movement.

questions.question: When did Naoya first expand the Time Cell Moon Palace?
questions.subject: Time Cell Moon Palace

answer.item: Naoya expanded his domain for the first time when he was pushed to his limits as a vengeful cursed spirit while fighting Maki Zenin, Hagane Daido, and Rokujushi Miyo.
